structure: Forge panel (prompt textarea + Manifest Image / Manifest Video buttons) + output panel. POSTs to /api/image and /api/video — expects Cloudflare Functions on the edge deployment; static file alone shows SIGNAL LOST.
agent_use: Pattern for the Hub's synthesis ordering UI: prompt in, artifact out, async with loading state. The /api/* convention matches the digest-worker.js pattern already in the package.
